title: Batch-stamp assignee opum-control on every ready task (DEC-152 OQ-1 dispatch precondition)
description: Every DEC-152 OQ-1 dispatch through opum-control is refused POLICY_DENIED ("task is not assigned to this controller (opum-control)") while the target task carries no assignee. Under the batch-once-per-repository rule, stamp assignee opum-control on every ready task in this repository in a single tracker-only change, so later routings are not refused. Filed by the quest-cli worker at team-lead instruction (DEC-172 expansion). Changes only the assignees field on each record.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every task ready at stamp time carries assignee opum-control, including QCLI-418 whose opum-control dispatch was refused.
No semantic field other than the assignees list changes on any stamped record; the only other delta is the automatically-updated updatedAt timestamp.
The change lands as one tracker-only pull request into dev with the required checks green.
